concept.description: The concept this step gives evidence for. Needed with checks.

prompt.description: What to change, and what to watch in the page.

html.description: The starting HTML: a body fragment or a whole document. Needed without jsx.

css.description: The starting CSS. With it, the learner gets a CSS tab.

js.description: The starting JavaScript, run after the HTML. Scripts run only when it is present.

jsx.description: A React component file, JSX or TSX. Its default export is rendered into #root.

editable.description: What the learner may edit. Default: every field the step has.

showTree.description: Show the live DOM tree next to the page.

checks.description: The checklist. With checks the step is scored.

label.description: What the learner sees in the checklist, for example "The page has one h1".

selector.description: A CSS selector, for example "h1" or "img[alt]".

count.description: The exact number of matches. Without it, at least one must match.

text.description: Words the first match contains, compared trimmed and ignoring case.

value.description: The exact value. Without it, the attribute must exist.

style.description: A computed style of the first match. Layout sizes such as width are not checked.

value.description: The computed value, as a browser reports it: a colour in its rgb form, a length in px.

actions.description: Clicks and typing, run in order on a fresh render before the check looks. React playgrounds only.

click.description: A CSS selector. The first match is clicked.

type.description: The text to type, one character at a time.

into.description: A CSS selector of an input or textarea. The first match gets the text.

solution.description: The finished fields. Needed with checks; the gate runs the checks on it.

items.description: A hint.

concept.description: The concept this step gives evidence for. Needed with checks.

prompt.description: What to find or change.

setup.description: Tables and seed rows, run fresh before every attempt.

starter.description: The SQL the editor starts with.

solution.description: SQL that gives the right result. Needed with checks.

checks.description: With checks the step is scored.

ordered.description: Compare row order too. Default false.

query.description: Compare what this query returns after the SQL, for a step that changes rows.

showSchema.description: Show the tables beside the editor.

items.description: A hint.

recap.description: Three lines shown on the summary screen (docs/WRITING-GUIDE.md, rule 25).

items.description: One thing the learner can now do, in one short sentence.

front.description: A question that needs a produced answer, not a yes or no.

back.description: The answer, in one or two sentences.

note.description: One line on why to read it.

primary.description: True for the one or two readings that matter most.

deepDive.description: Optional depth below the fold. Never needed for the scored steps.
